page_title: VIL 4-0 MAL | Villarreal v Mallorca 20/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Jose Munuera has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Johan Mojica (Mallorca), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

90+3' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) fires the ball from the free kick, directing it towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper stretches to punch the ball away. What an excellent save. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Alex Baena (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Jose Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Mallorca.
90+2' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Now Mallorca have a corner.
90+1' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Jose Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
89' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) commits a foul during an attacking move.
86' Substitution. Pape Gueye makes his way off the pitch and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) comes on as his replacement.
84' Martin Valjent looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Jagoba Arrasate has decided that Valery (Mallorca) is the man to take his place.
84' Referee Jose Munuera halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jagoba Arrasate, then shows him a yellow.
83' It doesn’t look good for Martin Valjent (Mallorca); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
81' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
79' Villarreal take a short corner kick.

79' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

78' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

78' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
76' Substitution. Thierno Barry makes way for Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
76' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Dani Parejo is replaced by Denis Suarez (Villarreal).
75' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
74' Substitution. Takuma Asano (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cyle Larin walks off.
71' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
71' The attendance is 14852.
68' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Gerard Moreno will be replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
68' It's time for a substitution. Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) comes on in place of Juan Foyth.
67' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Mallorca will take a corner kick.
64' Alex Baena (Villarreal) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
63' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Alex Baena (Villarreal), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
63' A pass into the box finds Alex Baena (Villarreal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the top right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Dominik Greif denies him.
63' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Munuera signals. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Villarreal.
60' It will be a substitution. Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) is ready to enter the pitch as Yeremy Pino walks off.

58' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
54' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Alex Baena (Villarreal) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
52' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Villarreal win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
50' The ball is cleared after Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a throw-in.
47' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
47' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Villarreal have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Samu Costa (Mallorca) will not participate anymore and Jose Copete is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Jagoba Arrasate decided to make a change. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is replaced by Antonio Sanchez.
46' Jagoba Arrasate makes a half-time substitution. Mateu Morey Bauza comes on in place of Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca).
46' Jagoba Arrasate makes a switch. Robert Navarro is coming on in place of Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Jose Munuera starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
45+2' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Samu Costa (Mallorca) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
43' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

43' Samu Costa (Mallorca) gets inside the box and tries to beat Junior Reis with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The ball is out of play. Mallorca win a corner kick.
42' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
40' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Munuera had an easy-decision to make.

39' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
37' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Junior Reis intercepts the ball.
36' What a big chance! Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
36' A cross into the box from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared.
34' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.

33' Wasted opportunity! Sergi Darder (Mallorca) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
32' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Dominik Greif.
31' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
28' 4 - 0 Goal! Sergi Cardona sends a precise cross into the box, Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:0.
26' 3 - 0 Dani Parejo (Villarreal) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
24' 2 - 0 Goal! Alex Baena (Villarreal) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Sergi Cardona. The score is 2:0.

20' 1 - 0 Logan Costa (Villarreal) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
20' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner.
20' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
18' A clumsy foul by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) and Jose Munuera blows his whistle. Mallorca win a free kick.
16' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Junior Reis makes a comfortable save.
13' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

12' Close! Pape Gueye (Villarreal) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
10' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
9' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but Dominik Greif comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Villarreal.
5' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' A pass from Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is intercepted by Junior Reis and the move breaks down.
2' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
